Players Committee card image of [[Allegiant General Pryde]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is lost. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/allegiantgeneralpryde.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/allegiantgeneralpryde.gif] as of commit a5142dd “Tweak set images” (12 May 2020).
